report.headline: Transport delays from plant to DC caused the Pearlguard Toothpaste 150g stockout at Bengaluru DC on 6 Aug
report.narrative: Transport delays from plant to DC caused the Pearlguard Toothpaste 150g stockout at Bengaluru DC on 6 Aug. The team first confirmed 'Safety stock set too low for demand variability', then rolled it back: breaches were 2.4% in weeks 12-7 but 57.1% in weeks 6-1: they began only after 'Transport delays from plant to DC' started draining stock, so this is a symptom, not a root cause.

causes.cause: Transport delays from plant to DC
causes.action: Escalate the plant-to-Bengaluru DC lane with logistics: deliveries ran 35% over standard lead time (visible from 2 Jul). Fix the delays; extra safety stock would only hide them.

ruled_out.why: -1.1% vs threshold above 10%: within normal range
99.0% vs threshold below 95%: within normal range

provenance.sql:
SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_date <= required_delivery_date
                      THEN COALESCE(accepted_qty, 0) ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(SUM(ordered_qty), 0) AS value,
       COUNT(*) AS orders_in_window, SUM(ordered_qty) AS ordered_qty
FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
WHERE sku_id = '100562' AND dc_id = 'DC3'
  AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 1)

SELECT 1.0 * (SUM(actual_demand_qty) - SUM(forecast_qty))
       / NULLIF(SUM(actual_demand_qty), 0) AS value,
       SUM(actual_demand_qty) AS actual_demand_qty, SUM(forecast_qty) AS forecast_qty
FROM scm_planning_01.demand_daily
WHERE sku_id = '100562' AND dc_id = 'DC3' AND demand_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 1)

SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS breach_days,
       COUNT(*) AS days_observed, MAX(n.safety_stock_days) AS safety_stock_days
FROM scm_wms.inventory_snapshots s
JOIN scm_wms.inventory_norms n ON s.sku_id = n.sku_id AND s.dc_id = n.dc_id
WHERE s.sku_id = '100562' AND s.dc_id = 'DC3' AND s.snapshot_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 1)

SELECT order_id, ordered_qty, accepted_qty, dispatch_date, required_delivery_date,
       delivery_date, std_lead_time_days
FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
WHERE sku_id = '100562' AND dc_id = 'DC3' AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 1)
ORDER BY required_delivery_date

SELECT s.snapshot_date, s.on_hand_qty, s.days_on_hand, n.safety_stock_days
FROM scm_wms.inventory_snapshots s
JOIN scm_wms.inventory_norms n ON s.sku_id = n.sku_id AND s.dc_id = n.dc_id
WHERE s.sku_id = '100562' AND s.dc_id = 'DC3' AND s.snapshot_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 1)
ORDER BY s.snapshot_date

SELECT 1.0 * SUM(COALESCE(accepted_qty, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(ordered_qty), 0) AS value,
       SUM(COALESCE(accepted_qty, 0)) AS accepted_qty, SUM(ordered_qty) AS ordered_qty
FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
WHERE sku_id = '100562' AND dc_id = 'DC3'
  AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 1)

SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_date <= required_delivery_date
                      THEN accepted_qty ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(SUM(accepted_qty), 0) AS value,
       SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_date > required_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_orders,
       COUNT(*) AS orders_in_window
FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
WHERE sku_id = '100562' AND dc_id = 'DC3'
  AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 1) AND accepted_qty IS NOT NULL

SELECT order_id, ordered_qty, accepted_qty, dispatch_date, required_delivery_date,
       delivery_date, std_lead_time_days
FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
WHERE sku_id = '100562' AND dc_id = 'DC3' AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 1)
ORDER BY required_delivery_date

SELECT AVG(1.0 * GREATEST(0, datediff(LEAST(COALESCE(delivery_date, DATE '2026-08-06'), DATE '2026-08-06'),
                                      dispatch_date) - std_lead_time_days)
           / std_lead_time_days) AS value,
       AVG(1.0 * datediff(LEAST(COALESCE(delivery_date, DATE '2026-08-06'), DATE '2026-08-06'),
                          dispatch_date)) AS avg_actual_lead_time_days,
       MAX(std_lead_time_days) AS std_lead_time_days,
       SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(delivery_date, DATE '2026-08-06') > required_delivery_date
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_or_overdue_orders
FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
WHERE sku_id = '100562' AND dc_id = 'DC3'
  AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 1)

SELECT order_id, ordered_qty, accepted_qty, dispatch_date, required_delivery_date,
       delivery_date, std_lead_time_days
FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
WHERE sku_id = '100562' AND dc_id = 'DC3' AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 1)
ORDER BY required_delivery_date

SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.snapshot_date < date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 42)
                       AND s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.snapshot_date < date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 42) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS early_rate,
       1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.snapshot_date >= date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 42)
                       AND s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.snapshot_date >= date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 42) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS late_rate,
       COUNT(*) AS days_observed
FROM scm_wms.inventory_snapshots s
JOIN scm_wms.inventory_norms n ON s.sku_id = n.sku_id AND s.dc_id = n.dc_id
WHERE s.sku_id = '100562' AND s.dc_id = 'DC3' AND s.snapshot_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', 1)

SELECT SUM(actual_demand_qty - fulfilled_qty) AS lost_units,
       SUM(CASE WHEN actual_demand_qty > fulfilled_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS short_days
FROM scm_planning_01.demand_daily
WHERE sku_id = '100562' AND dc_id = 'DC3' AND demand_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-06' AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-06', -27)
